release: LabFlow Lite 1.1 — My bookings and cancel (US-11)

requirements.text: 30-minute grid inside 07:00–21:00; two bookings of one lab never overlap
At most 14 days ahead, counted in Viet Nam's calendar
A student's booking for more than 30 seats waits for approval
A booking lasts at most 4 hours
Lecturers and admins never need approval
A booking can be cancelled until 60 minutes before it starts (Viet Nam time)
My bookings lists only my own bookings, by date and start, cancelled ones too
I can cancel my own booking until 60 minutes before it starts; at 59 minutes: TOO_LATE_TO_CANCEL
Someone else's booking looks missing (404): nobody learns it exists
Cancelling twice — even at the same moment — succeeds once: ALREADY_CANCELLED
A cancelled slot can be booked again
An admin may cancel any booking, at any time
5 wrong passwords in a row lock the account for 15 minutes (library only; the demo login does not use it)
Check-in window (library only, no endpoint yet)
No-show ban (library only, no endpoint yet)
Weekly series for lecturers (library only, no endpoint yet)
